info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Healthcare Appointments Notes-v5-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Notes Retrieval API allows users to access notes associated with healthcare appointments efficiently. This endpoint serves healthcare professionals who need to review patient notes for better care coordination and management. It provides relevant information necessary for making informed decisions about patient treatment plans and follow-up actions. Typical consumers include doctors, nurses, and clinic staff who are involved in patient care and documentation.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve all notes linked to their appointments, enabling easy access to important information and reminders for scheduled meetings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve notes associated with appointments. Ensure that the request is properly formatted as per the specified schema to successfully obtain the desired notes.
